2609.35641.title: Verifiable Visual Rewards Transfer from Synthetic Scenes to Natural Prompts
2609.35641.paper_summary: Precise instruction following in image generation, such as satisfying object counts and spatial relations, remains an open challenge at least in part because it is learned using unreliable reward models such as object detectors and vision-language models. We introduce Verifiable Visual Rewards (VVR), the first framework for programmatically verifiable image rewards, and show that training on it generalizes to natural prompts. Each VVR task is a scene of geometric objects and relations among them, from which we derive both the prompt and a deterministic verifier, so tasks can be generated in any number and at any chosen complexity. We release VVRBench, with 10,000 tasks over 32 constraint types, and VVRBench-Challenge, with 720 more complex tasks; the strongest model we evaluate---GPT-Image-2.5---solves 21.4% of VVRBench-Challenge. Using VVR scores as rewards for reinforcement learning (RLVVR) raises the accuracy of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium on VVRBench from 2.8% to 28.3% and demonstrates consistent easy-to-hard generalization. These gains extend to out-of-domain benchmarks, and mixing VVR into existing objectives further improves overall performance and human preference, motivating the adoption of VVR into standard image generation post-training recipes.
2609.35641.paper_summary_zh: 精確的指令遵循在圖像生成中，例如滿足物體數量和空間關係，仍然是一個未解決的挑戰，部分原因是它是使用不可靠的獎勵模型學習的，例如物體檢測器和視覺-語言模型。我們引入了可驗證的視覺獎勵（VVR），這是第一個可以程序化驗證的圖像獎勵框架，並顯示在其上進行訓練可以推廣到自然提示。每個VVR任務都是幾何物體及其之間關係的場景，從中我們推導出提示和確定性驗證器，因此任務可以以任意數量和選擇的複雜性生成。我們發布了VVRBench，包含10,000個任務，涵蓋32種類型的約束，還有VVRBench-Challenge，包含720個更複雜的任務；我們評估的最強模型---GPT-Image-2.5---解決了21.4%的VVRBench-Challenge。使用VVR分數作為強化學習（RLVVR）的獎勵，將穩定擴散3.5中等版在VVRBench上的準確率從2.8%提高到28.3%，並顯示出一致的由易到難的推廣能力。這些增益擴展到域外基準，並將VVR混入現有目標進一步改善整體性能和人類偏好，促進了VVR在標準圖像生成後訓練配方中的採用。
